basis: GIS-maintained regional associations for review, not NWS reach forecasts, hazard polygons or county-approved staging areas. Every association is bound to the reviewed source PDF revision.

associations.note: Valley / western-hills rainfall provides regional context for these review groups. It is not a prediction of inundation along the reach or at nearby assets.

Foothill / lower-Sierra context around the listed gauge or dam locations. For Kings below Pine Flat this is dam-vicinity context, not full downstream coverage. The dated partner deck requires verification.
High-Sierra headwater context only. Reference gauges and nearby roads or facilities are not assumed above 8,000 ft or exposed to snow. No snowmelt, runoff or river travel-time model is applied.
